lines.text: Leo ran ahead to see the creek.
When he turned around, the trail looked different, and his dad was gone.
Here's the fix, taught before the hike.
If you're lost, stay put and hug a tree.
Blow your whistle three times, and keep blowing.
Staying in one place makes you easier to find.
His dad heard the whistle within minutes.
Teach your kids these rules at the trailhead.
Save this for your next family hike.
